title: Paris Johnson: Mindset is to be a $40 million man because guys I block make that

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Paris Johnson: Mindset is to be a $40 million man because guys I block make that
sources.description: The Cardinals locked up left tackle Paris Johnson through the 2027 season by exercising their $19 million option on his contract, but that hasn't stopped him from starting to think about his next long-term contract.
